name: python
description: Python project: ruff (format + lint) + pyright + pytest, diff coverage via diff-cover, plus the harness designs/integrity/memory gates.
setup: pip install ruff pyright pytest (or add them to your dev dependencies / uv tool set)

Optional: `pip install pytest-cov diff-cover`, set gates.test.command to 'pytest --cov=src --cov-report=xml' and gates.coverage.command in agentic.config.json to: diff-cover coverage.xml --compare-branch origin/main --fail-under 80
Optional: pip install build and keep the 'build' gate if you ship a package; remove it (or leave optional) for apps
Optional: set gates.e2e.command in agentic.config.json when you have an end-to-end suite
Note: the harness itself still needs Node >= 20 (./scripts/bootstrap.sh); .agentic/harness/ is language-independent — delete the root package.json, keep .agentic/harness/
